scope: Primary-source-only feasibility decision using repository-vendored evidence; no opaque scraping and no newly invented source metadata.
requirementsForImplement: licence or redistribution terms compatible with a vendored local snapshot
explicit support for one-to-many and many-to-one postal relationships
reason: The allowed repository evidence does not prove an authoritative, maintainable, licensable nationwide CAP↔Comune dataset. The product must not infer postal coverage from municipality/Belfiore codes or substitute an opaque scraped dataset.
reopenWhen: Reopen only when an authoritative nationwide source with explicit licence/redistribution terms, update/version semantics, and reproducible sample coverage is vendored or an existing repository fetch pipeline is added and reviewed.
